metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started on flightaware.com with Cloudflare verification. Clicked to verify human, page loaded, accepted cookies. Then spent many turns scrolling to find the community section. Eventually found 'Discussion' link in the footer and navigated to discussions.flightaware.com. Task failed because the agent opened the wrong discussion (not the one with the most replies).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate browser pages, click links, scroll pages, accept cookie banners on flightaware.com.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed around step 7 — kept scrolling the main page instead of directly navigating to the community section. Eventually reached discussions.flightaware.com at step 12 but chose the wrong discussion.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single intermediate sub-goal: navigate to discussions.flightaware.com. This was achieved in the trajectory at step 12 (after the deviation but before the final wrong click), making it a reachable target for the model.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from flightaware.com to discussions.flightaware.com. The evaluator uses is_expected_url_pattern_match to verify the active tab URL contains 'discussions.flightaware.com'. Initial state (flightaware.com open) does not pass the check.
